## Transforming care experiences with real-time customer insights.

### Monitor patient workflows in real time.

Track scheduling, onboarding, and test result flows—detecting and resolving issues before they disrupt care.

### Understand where patients struggle.

Use AI-generated summaries to surface frustration and intent across the entire digital care journey.

### Continuously optimize key journeys.

## Fix digital friction before it delays care or drives calls.

Session replay and quantified impact help you spot issues like confusing scheduling flows or broken form submissions—before patients drop off or flood the call center. Prioritize what matters most with behavioral insights tied to real outcomes.

## FAQ

### How does Quantum Metric support healthcare operations?

Quantum Metric gives hospitals, clinics, and care providers full visibility into digital patient journeys—from appointment scheduling to test result access. This helps teams fix issues before they impact care or trigger support calls.

### Can Quantum Metric connect digital and call center data?

Yes. By linking session activity with call center data using patient or member IDs, Quantum Metric helps providers uncover the digital root causes of high-volume support drivers.

### How does Felix AI help healthcare teams?

Felix AI summarizes user sessions, detects intent, and recommends fixes—helping care delivery teams resolve issues faster, reduce patient friction, and lower support costs.

### What types of data does Quantum Metric capture?

We capture behavioral (clicks, taps), technical (errors, load times), and transactional (e.g., appointment bookings, test result views) data across hospital portals, mobile apps, and EHR platforms.

### Can Quantum Metric help reduce call volume?

Absolutely. Healthcare systems have deflected thousands of support calls by resolving the digital causes of confusion, slowdowns, and access issues across key patient workflows.

### Is Quantum Metric HIPAA-compliant and how do you handle PHI?

Yes. Quantum Metric is HIPAA-ready and SOC 2 Type II certified. We do not collect protected health information (PHI) or personally identifiable information (PII) by default. This ensures that pharmacy and healthcare teams can gain behavioral insights while maintaining compliance with HIPAA, PCI, and other privacy regulations.

### Can Quantum Metric integrate with our existing health IT stack?

Yes. Quantum Metric integrates seamlessly with CRMs, EHRs (like Epic and MyChart), IVR systems, and digital front ends—embedding insights into hospital and clinic workflows.

### How quickly can provider teams resolve issues with Quantum Metric?

Teams across hospitals and provider groups have reduced issue resolution from weeks to hours—and often fix high-impact problems within minutes of detection.
